name: suppression-collision
summary: Row already exists in the suppression or CRM source
origin: Suppress before you enrich, not after.

name: recent-contact
summary: Row was contacted inside the cooling-off window
origin: Deal stage misses somebody who was called yesterday.

name: do-not-call
summary: Number appears on the do-not-call source
origin: Remove, never flag.

name: restricted-jurisdiction
summary: Row sits in a jurisdiction you configured as restricted for this motion
origin: You configured this jurisdiction as restricted for this motion. The tool does not determine which jurisdictions are legally restricted — that is your call with counsel. This gate enforces your decision, not a legal determination.

name: missing-trigger
summary: Row carries no specific, checkable reason for the outreach
origin: Empty personalisation is worse than none.

name: unrendered-copy
summary: Copy still contains placeholders, raw values, or holes
origin: Sending tools print whatever is in the cell.

name: email-unverified
summary: Address is unverified or on a catch-all domain
origin: Catch-all passes verification and then bounces.

name: mailbox-shape
summary: Address is a role mailbox, a free provider, or off-domain
origin: A reply nobody owns is a reply nobody answers.

name: name-domain-mismatch
summary: Company name and domain do not correspond
origin: Name matches lie.

name: non-operating-entity
summary: Row is a fund, holding entity, or property vehicle
origin: Filing sources are majority non-operating entities.

name: headcount-ceiling
summary: Row is larger than the motion is built for
origin: One explicit ceiling beats an implicit filter.

name: headcount-floor
summary: List looks filtered on size rather than scored on it
origin: Score size, never filter on it.

name: duplicate-account
summary: The same account appears on more than one row
origin: Two rows become two reps on one account.

name: duplicate-phone
summary: Same phone number appears on multiple accounts
origin: A shared main number is the most common enrichment failure.

name: stale-enrichment
summary: Enrichment data is older than the configured freshness threshold
origin: A list that was clean when built is not clean when sent.

name: missing-recipient
summary: Row carries no recipient name at all
origin: A nameless row sends to nobody and costs the same.

name: title-scope
summary: Title indicates the wrong seniority for the motion
origin: An intern cannot sign a contract.

name: dnc-source-staleness
summary: DNC source file is older than the configured scrubbing interval
origin: A stale DNC list is a historical document, not a compliance tool.

name: calling-hours
summary: Send time falls outside legal calling hours for the recipient's jurisdiction
origin: Calling-hour windows are an operational safeguard, not legal advice.

name: email-length
summary: Copy exceeds 150 words for a first-touch email
origin: The goal is a reply, not a pitch.

name: links-in-first-email
summary: Copy contains a link or URL in a first-touch email
origin: Links trigger spam filters on cold outreach.

name: multiple-ctas
summary: Copy contains more than one call-to-action
origin: One email, one ask.
